JsTrackerCustom.AddCustomJs: Add custom JavaScript code to your piwik.js
JsTrackerCustom.CustomJsAppliesToAllSites: The code you add here is stored in the global JavaScript tracker file and is therefore loaded for all of your sites. If you want to add JavaScript for one site only, we recommend using a Custom HTML tag in Tag Manager instead.
JsTrackerCustom.DirectoryOrFileNotWritable: To be able to add custom JavaScript, the directory %1$s needs to be writable or the file %2$s needs to be writable.
JsTrackerCustom.FileNotWritable: To be able to add custom JavaScript, the file %1$s needs to be writable.
